title: Real-time fraud scoring on GKE + Spanner
summary: Strong multi-region Spanner design. Conditions: replace exported SA keys with Workload Identity, add VPC-SC perimeter, burn-rate alerting on scoring SLO.

title: Black-Friday storefront on single Compute Engine VM
summary: Single zonal VM and self-managed MySQL on the request path could not meet 99.9% SLO; no autoscaling; public SSH. Redesign on Cloud Run + Cloud SQL HA behind Cloud Armor.

title: Clinical notes summarisation with Gemini on Vertex AI
summary: Good grounding via Vertex AI Search. Conditions: BAA + CMEK on PHI buckets, Model Armor screening, clinician human review before notes are written back to EHR.

title: IoT telemetry lakehouse on Pub/Sub, Dataflow and BigQuery
summary: Well partitioned BigQuery, decoupled ingestion, Terraform everywhere, CUDs on baseline Dataflow. Approved as-is.
